races.name: Molson Coors Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Heights Lane
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity with hold-up style perfectly suited to this weak pace scenario, lightly raced with scope for improvement

runners_data.name: Kenobi
runners_data.note: Will lead unchallenged but sustainable pace may leave him vulnerable to stronger finishers, 39 days since last run could be ideal

runners_data.name: Popalot
runners_data.note: Hold-up style gives him every chance in this shape, Peter Niven's poor recent record (0/2) is concerning

runners_data.name: Berks And Bucks
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who should benefit from the pace collapse, 54-day break freshens him up nicely

runners_data.name: Fidendum
runners_data.note: Highest RPR of 116 with perfect hold-up style for this race shape, claiming jockey takes off valuable weight

runners_data.name: Calibos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong form figures, significantly lighter weight at 152lbs gives him a key advantage

runners_data.name: Edelak
runners_data.note: Class act from powerful Skelton yard resuming after 153-day break, prominent style suits if fitness holds up

runners_data.name: Pour Tout Le Monde
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated prominent runner will struggle against this field despite the tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Papa Oscar
runners_data.note: Hold-up style fits but poor form and low rating make him hard to fancy despite weight concessions

runners_data.name: Pink Walls
runners_data.note: Weakest horse in the field with hold-up style, even perfect race shape unlikely to overcome class deficit

races.paceDynamic: Kenobi will take the field along as the only genuine front runner, joined in the early stages by the prominent runners Calibos, Edelak, and Pour Tout Le Monde. With no serious pace pressure, Kenobi can dictate comfortable fractions while the hold-up horses Heights Lane, Popalot, Berks And Bucks, Fidendum, Papa Oscar, and Pink Walls settle towards the rear. The lack of early pace will create a bunched field turning for home, setting up a sprint finish where positioning and finishing speed become crucial. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can produce their best work late when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kenobi sets modest fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the patient riders to get into perfect position before unleashing their charges in the final furlong. Hold-up specialists with class like Heights Lane and Fidendum can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can secure good jumping positions without overexerting
scenarios.body: Calibos and Edelak can track Kenobi comfortably before quickening clear when the pace lifts, using their tactical speed to gain crucial lengths. Their ability to be handy without leading gives them the perfect launching pad.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Kenobi goes too slowly and creates a messy finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of ability rather than stamina, allowing the highest-rated horses to showcase their class regardless of position. Quality rises to the top when tactical advantage is neutralized.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Kenobi gets his fractions right and holds off all challengers
scenarios.body: The leader maintains just enough pace to blunt the finishing kicks while staying strong enough to repel late challenges. His unchallenged position throughout gives him the energy reserves needed for the finish.

watchPoints.text: Kenobi could steal this if he gets his fractions right and the field fails to organize behind him
Heights Lane is the unknown quantity who could have significant improvement in him for this perfect race setup
Fidendum's fitness after 22 days off needs monitoring but his RPR advantage is significant
The prominent runners Calibos and Edelak need to avoid getting drawn into any early pace battle
Watch for late moves from the hold-up horses turning for home when the pace finally lifts

races.name: Lucas Machinery Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Character Testing
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid recent form who can track Bouquet De Paris and has the tactical speed to challenge

runners_data.name: Klapton Boy
runners_data.note: Likes to race prominently but unproven apprentice jockey may struggle with tactical demands in this company

runners_data.name: Granny B
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to be effective, lightweight helps but may get outpaced early

runners_data.name: Bunker Bay
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse returning quickly, trainer struggling for winners and needs pace to develop

runners_data.name: Bouquet De Paris
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who should get comfortable lead, Rebecca Curtis in decent form recently

runners_data.name: Lord Of The Glance
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent racer in good form with recent winner, Bryan Carver booking is positive

runners_data.name: Made All
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after long break, name suggests front-running but recent runs show patient tactics

runners_data.name: Macho Sun
runners_data.note: Needs strong pace to be effective, bottom weight helps but apprentice claim may hinder tactical positioning

runners_data.name: Allibaba
runners_data.note: Long absence is major concern despite light weight, hold-up style needs race to develop strongly

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Skelton string running well but this horse fades in finish, needs everything to fall right from rear

runners_data.name: Susiesparkle
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer from same stable as Macho Sun, lightweight but poor recent form

races.paceDynamic: Bouquet De Paris will take the early lead with minimal pressure, as most rivals prefer to settle behind. Character Testing, Klapton Boy and Lord Of The Glance may track in prominent positions but none are confirmed pace pressers. This creates a controlled tempo that allows the leader to dictate fractions and potentially steal a march turning for home. The lack of genuine pace pressure and sustainable gallop strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bouquet Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Bouquet De Paris gets an uncontested lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The four-year-old can dictate a comfortable tempo and kick clear when ready, with any prominent tracker needing to find extra gear late. This controlled pace scenario heavily favours those who can race handy and avoid getting outpaced.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners applies mild pressure and times their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Character Testing or Lord Of The Glance could sit in Bouquet's slipstream before producing a telling late burst when the leader's kick comes. The race becomes a tactical battle between the front division.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple prominent runners engaged early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop would set up perfectly for a closer like Granny B or Bunker Bay to produce a sweeping finish. However, this requires much more pace pressure than the field composition suggests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Long-Range Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from two out
scenarios.body: Made All or another held-up runner could benefit from a bunched field and messy finish where class tells late. This requires multiple pace judgement errors from the front-runners.

watchPoints.text: Bouquet De Paris setting fractions - if uncontested through first mile, will be very hard to peg back
Character Testing's early positioning - needs to be handy to use tactical pace but not waste energy tracking too closely
Lord Of The Glance for market confidence - recent winner whose connections are in good form
How quickly the hold-up horses can travel - if Granny B or Bunker Bay are struggling to keep tabs early, they're out of it
Apprentice jockeys on Klapton Boy and both Sowersby runners - tactical errors could prove costly in this type of race

races.name: Tiff And Ang Go West Stakes Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Isle Of Sark
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 28-day break, but facing a tactical disadvantage in a race lacking early pace with his 166lb burden.

runners_data.name: Cloudy Wednesday
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who can exploit the tactical setup, though 10-year-old legs and 32-day gap need monitoring.

runners_data.name: Jasmin De Cotte
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with Dan Skelton's red-hot 14-day form (9/26), but needs pace collapse to be effective from the back.

runners_data.name: Let Me Go Boys
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 186-day layoff, making tactical demands even harder to meet despite reasonable course record.

runners_data.name: Lone Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with significant weight advantage (142lbs) and recent 15-day turnaround suggesting connections are confident.

runners_data.name: El Muchacho
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent form including a win, but the 161lb burden makes his task harder in a potentially tactical affair.

runners_data.name: Forsa Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose forward position gives her a tactical edge, though Ellie Callwood's 7lb claim brings inexperience concerns.

races.paceDynamic: Cloudy Wednesday will lead from the gate with minimal pressure, as Forsa Bay is the only other forward-running type and sits just prominent rather than leading. This creates a sustainable gallop through the early stages, with the large pack of hold-up horses (Isle Of Sark, Jasmin De Cotte, Let Me Go Boys, Lone Soldier, El Muchacho) tracking behind. The lack of pace pressure means Cloudy Wednesday can dictate fractions and kick when ready, while the hold-up brigade faces a tactical puzzle with limited early speed to aim at. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent runners who can avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cloudy Wednesday Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudy Wednesday maintains his jumping rhythm and isn't pressed for pace early.
scenarios.body: He can dictate the fractions and time his effort perfectly, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the leaders who get first run. His recent good form and front-running style perfectly suits this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swamps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the hold-up horses get a perfect setup to unleash late.
scenarios.body: Jasmin De Cotte or El Muchacho can use their higher class ratings and strong recent form to pick off the leaders in the final furlong. The Skelton team's excellent 14-day strike rate gives Jasmin De Cotte a significant trainer angle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Forsa Bay Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Forsa Bay can improve on Cloudy Wednesday's pace and get first run on the field.
scenarios.body: Her prominent position gives her tactical advantage over the hold-up horses, and despite the 7lb claim, she can exploit the lack of early pace. The step up in trip should suit her profile perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lone Soldier Surges
scenarios.trigger: If the light weight (142lbs) and Sean Bowen's tactical nous can overcome the 186-day absence.
scenarios.body: His recent second at this course suggests Market Rasen suits, and the big weight advantage could prove decisive in a slowly-run race. The long absence remains a significant question mark despite his course form.

watchPoints.text: Cloudy Wednesday's jumping rhythm early - any mistakes will invite pressure and ruin his tactical advantage.
How aggressively Forsa Bay travels in the first mile - if she gets keen it could set up the hold-up horses perfectly.
Whether any of the hold-up horses attempt to improve their position earlier than usual given the lack of natural pace.
Jasmin De Cotte's position turning for home - if he's too far back the lack of pace won't help him get there.
Let Me Go Boys' fitness levels after 186 days off - any signs of rustiness will end his chances quickly.

races.name: Summer Plate Ladies Day Saturday 18th July Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Courtland
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong RPR 135 who benefits from the expected strong pace but hasn't won for 34 days

runners_data.name: Classic King
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse with quality jockey Cobden aboard, though trainer Emma Lavelle running at low 5% strike-rate

runners_data.name: Giovanni Change
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form with recent win, carries just 147lbs but faces stronger opposition

runners_data.name: Annsam
runners_data.note: Tracking type who hasn't won on similar good ground in recent runs despite multiple placings

runners_data.name: Bumpy Evans
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with solid recent form but trainer Kerry Lee has no winners from last 2 runners

runners_data.name: Ira Hayes
runners_data.note: Will lead early but lowest TopSpeed rating of 94 suggests may struggle to maintain gallop over 3m trip

races.paceDynamic: Bumpy Evans and Ira Hayes will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop over this 3m trip. Giovanni Change and Annsam may track the leaders in behind, while the two highest-rated horses Courtland and Classic King both prefer to be held up. The dual pace angle should create an honest tempo that suits the patient tactics of the hold-up horses. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up merchants who can capitalise on the expected strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans and Ira Hayes establish a strong early gallop as expected
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for Courtland and Classic King to unleash their finishing kicks from the rear. Both top-rated hold-up specialists should find plenty of tired horses ahead of them in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and burns out the leaders
scenarios.body: Giovanni Change and Annsam can capitalise from their tracking positions, having avoided the early speed battle. Their prominent style allows them to stay in touch without getting embroiled in the pace war.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead after the other falters early
scenarios.body: Bumpy Evans has the stronger recent form and could dictate terms if Ira Hayes doesn't last the early exchanges. His three wins from twelve runs on good ground shows he can capitalise when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and come back dramatically in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where stamina and class tell over pure finishing speed. The older horses with experience of tactical races could benefit from the lack of a true pace test.

watchPoints.text: Bumpy Evans must be watched for how much he has left after setting the pace, as his recent fall at Uttoxeter may have affected confidence
Classic King's finishing kick depends entirely on getting the strong pace his hold-up style requires from the two leaders
Giovanni Change carries significantly less weight at 147lbs which could prove decisive if the race becomes competitive
Ira Hayes has the lowest speed figures and may fold quickly if pressed hard by Bumpy Evans in the early stages
Courtland at age 11 needs to show he retains his finishing speed after 34 days off the track

races.name: Victor Lucas Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ebony Warrior
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 157-day break which raises fitness concerns despite previous course winner credentials.

runners_data.name: Champagne Twist
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but inconsistent recent form and trainer's moderate 14-day record create question marks.

runners_data.name: Escapologist
runners_data.note: Natural prominent runner with solid recent fourth at Goodwood showing he retains ability over similar distances.

runners_data.name: Into The Park
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent third but trainer's poor strike rate this month undermines confidence.

runners_data.name: Porter In The Park
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent performer whose recent consistent placings suggest he's primed for another bold showing.

runners_data.name: Idefix De Ciergues
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with recent Southwell win confirming he's operating at peak effectiveness.

runners_data.name: Tiger Orchid
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist whose recent string of placings demonstrates he remains competitive despite his 11 years.

runners_data.name: Dramatic License
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with useful course form but long layoff and unfamiliar jockey combination create tactical uncertainty.

runners_data.name: Ryebridge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose recent Southwell win shows he's in good heart but faces stronger opposition here.

runners_data.name: Huffin An A Puffin
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose back-to-back 20f wins suggest he's found his ideal trip and rhythm.

runners_data.name: Coumeenoole
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose recent Cheltenham win proves he handles step up in class and distance effectively.

races.paceDynamic: Huffin An A Puffin is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate from the start, with most of the field comprising prominent racers who'll track closely behind. Porter In The Park, Idefix De Ciergues, and Escapologist are likely to press forward early, creating a bunched leading group that could string out after the second-last hurdle. With only Tiger Orchid and Dramatic License committed to hold-up tactics, the pace pressure should be genuine throughout this 2m7f test. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can stay close to the pace without getting into an early speed battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Huffin Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Huffin An A Puffin gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear approaching the last, with the prominent brigade struggling to make up ground. Recent wins at 20f suggest he handles this longer trip when allowed to bowl along.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royal
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Huffin An A Puffin early
scenarios.body: Porter In The Park, Idefix De Ciergues and Coumeenoole engage in genuine pace pressure that sets up the race for a closer. The sustained gallop will test stamina reserves over this extended distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong between prominent runners
scenarios.body: Tiger Orchid can utilise his proven hold-up style to pick off tiring leaders, especially with good recent form showing multiple placings. His 11-year-old experience could prove decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Huffin An A Puffin stops quickly and prominent runners falter
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any survivor can prevail, potentially suiting a midfield tracker with fresh legs. This chaotic scenario opens the door for unconsidered runners.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Huffin An A Puffin gets pressed early by Porter In The Park or Idefix De Ciergues as sustained pace pressure could undermine his stamina reserves.
Monitor Tiger Orchid's position turning for home as his hold-up style needs the pace to collapse to be effective in this field.
Observe how Ebony Warrior travels early given his lengthy absence may have left him short of peak race fitness.
Check if multiple prominent runners bunch together after the third-last as this could create interference problems in the home straight.
Watch Coumeenoole's jumping rhythm as his recent Cheltenham success suggests he's adapted well to longer distances.

races.name: Fiver Friday Raceday Friday 12th June Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Top Flight Century
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has been running well in similar company, with Jack Power's 3lb claim valuable at this level

runners_data.name: Assorda
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who won impressively at Goodwood last time, though 24-day break may leave him short of peak fitness

runners_data.name: Nottodaybobo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose style could prove ideal if he can bridge the gap between leader and hold-up horses, Joshua Thompson takes 3lb off

runners_data.name: Matoury
runners_data.note: Long absence of 127 days is concerning despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace scenario

runners_data.name: Blue Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying just 146lbs with Oscar Palmer's 6lb claim, though his recent form figures are modest

runners_data.name: De Deli Counter
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will face no early pressure, making this a tactical dream scenario for his style

runners_data.name: Below The Belt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose tendency to fade in the finish is a serious concern despite the likely suitable pace

runners_data.name: Bargain Hunter
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer who fades late, though his featherweight of 142lbs could help compensate

races.paceDynamic: De Deli Counter is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely facing no early pressure from this field of predominantly hold-up horses. Nottodaybobo represents the only prominent runner but may track rather than challenge early, leaving De Deli Counter to bowl along at his own tempo. The sustainable pace will set up a tactical finish where horses need to find their positions and time their runs from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken late, as they'll get the perfect setup from an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If De Deli Counter gets his own way in front without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage through honest fractions and has enough left to resist late challengers. His recent Goodwood win proves he can make all when unopposed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade time their runs perfectly from the steady pace
scenarios.body: Top Flight Century or Assorda produce their trademark late kicks to sweep past a weakening leader in the final furlong. The sustainable gallop plays directly into their preferred running style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Nottodaybobo sits close and outsprints De Deli Counter
scenarios.body: The experienced handicapper uses his tactical speed to track the leader and proves too strong when it matters. His prominent style bridges the gap between pace-setting and hold-up tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Matoury or Blue Bear benefit from their weight advantage in the finish
scenarios.body: The featherweights find extra gear late despite their hold-up styles, with their significant weight pulls compensating for class deficits. The honest pace allows them to get competitive.

watchPoints.text: Below The Belt and Bargain Hunter both show concerning late fade patterns that could undermine any positional advantage they gain
Matoury's 127-day absence is lengthy even for a hold-up horse, watch for signs of rustiness early in the race
If Nottodaybobo fails to take up his prominent position early, it leaves De Deli Counter completely unattended in front
Top Flight Century has been running consistently well recently, watch for confident riding from Jack Power if travelling strongly turning in
De Deli Counter's early tempo will be crucial - if he goes too slow even for his own good, it hands the initiative to closers
